en: Fixed `claude agents` failing with "Couldn't restart the background service" and background sessions stopping after a Homebrew upgrade (takes effect from the upgrade after this one)
zh: 修复了 `claude agents` 报错“Couldn't restart the background service”，以及通过 Homebrew 升级后后台 session 停止的问题（从本次升级之后的下一次升级起生效）
